text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Tuesday:

- Swiss pharma giant Roche announced on Monday that it will take over pharma group Boehringer Mannheim and artificial joint maker DePuy. The two deals, which are worth $11 billion, will make Roche the world leader in diagnostics.

- The bilateral negotiations between Switzerland and the European Union may go on for another year. Swiss Transport Minister Moritz Leuenberger said on Monday the gap in the transport issue between the two sides was too wide to achieve a settlement in the immediate future.
- A wave of hospital privatisations may trigger a boost in health insurance premiums. CSS health insurer plans to counter this development with an public referendum.

- The inhabitants of Geneva will have to decide at the polls next weekend whether they want to impose an entrance fee for their museums. The city council proposed such a measure in order to improve the city's finances.
